blocks.text: Known as the “Gateway to the Arctic,” the Finnish city of Rovaniemi sits directly on the Arctic Circle. Its forests are glowing in autumn colors as European leaders gather here at the invitation of Finnish Prime Minister Petteri Orpo to discuss a new EU strategy for the Arctic. Climate change and Russia’s war against Ukraine have thrust the High North into the center of European attention. “There is a high demand for concrete EU action in the Arctic,” Orpo said. “Our security environment has changed fundamentally.
